title: Profile: IBM Agent Communication Protocol and its relation to A2A
goal: A different standard that shares the acronym ACP; document its REST model and its merge into A2A so the knowledge base never conflates the two. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
